description: Use when troubleshooting Linux server performance or stability issues — CPU saturation, high load, scheduling delay, memory pressure, OOM events, high RSS, page cache / shared memory growth, memory cgroup residue, Java heap issues, disk IO saturation or latency, packet loss, network jitter, or a server that is slow, stuck, or unstable. Performs diagnosis and surfaces recommendations; does not apply fixes automatically.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
